content:
Area under curves is where a rough sketch saves you. Draw the region wrong, and every integral after it goes to waste. This free JEE Area Under Curves online test rewards students who sketch first. It runs 15 MCQs with instant scoring. Each solution shows the limits and the setup. So sketch, shade, then integrate.

What JEE asks from Area Under Curves

  • Area between a curve and the x-axis.
  • Area between two curves like a line and a parabola.
  • Standard results for the circle, ellipse and parabola.
  • Regions split by points of intersection.
  • Sign of area for odd functions and folds.

Formulas to sketch and remember

  • Area equals the integral of top minus bottom.
  • A full circle of radius r has area pi r squared.
  • An ellipse with semi-axes a and b has area pi a b.
  • For y squared equal to four a x, use horizontal strips.

Mistakes that cost JEE marks

  • Forgetting to find the intersection points first.
  • Subtracting bottom from top in the wrong order.
  • Missing symmetry and doubling nothing.
  • Mixing vertical and horizontal strips midway.

quiz.title: JEE Area Under Curves Quiz
quiz.intro: Fifteen JEE-pattern questions. Sketch, pick an answer, then press Check my score.
quiz.about: JEE Maths DPP: Area Under Curves

questions.q: Find the area bounded by y = x², the x-axis and the lines x = 1 and x = 2.
Find the area of the region bounded by the curves y = x² and y = x.
questions.explanation: The curves meet at x = 0 and x = 1. Area = ∫₀¹ (x − x²) dx = 1/2 − 1/3 = 1/6.

questions.q: Find the area under y = √x between the x-axis and the lines x = 4 and x = 9.
The area enclosed between the parabolas y² = 20x and x² = 4y is
questions.explanation: For y² = 4ax and x² = 4by the enclosed area is 16ab/3. Here it gives 80/3.

questions.q: Calculate the total area enclosed by the circle x² + y² = 25.
questions.explanation: A circle x² + y² = r² has area π r². With r² = 25 the area is 25π.

questions.q: The area bounded by the parabola y² = 8x and its latus rectum is
questions.explanation: For y² = 4ax the area with the latus rectum is 8a²/3. Here a = 2, so it is 32/3.

questions.q: What is the area enclosed by the ellipse x²/16 + y²/9 = 1?
questions.explanation: An ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 has area π a b. With a = 4 and b = 3 the area is 12π.

questions.q: The area enclosed between the parabola y² = 8x and the line y = 2x is
questions.explanation: They meet at x = 0 and x = 2. Integrating the gap between them gives 4/3 square units.

questions.q: Find the area bounded by the parabola y = x² and the line y = 2x.
questions.explanation: The curves meet at x = 0 and x = 2. Area = ∫₀² (2x − x²) dx = 4 − 8/3 = 4/3.

questions.q: The area enclosed between the parabolas y² = 20x and x² = 20y is
questions.explanation: For y² = 4ax and x² = 4by the area is 16ab/3. Here both curves give 400/3.

questions.q: The area under the curve y = 1/x from x = 2 to x = 8 is
questions.explanation: Area = ∫₂⁸ dx/x = ln(8/2) = ln 4. Only the ratio of limits matters.

questions.q: Calculate the area of the region bounded by the parabola x² = 4y and the line y = 3.
To find the area bounded by x = f(y), the y-axis and the lines y = c and y = d, you integrate with respect to which variable?
questions.explanation: With horizontal boundaries and a curve given in y, integrate ∫_c^d f(y) dy with respect to y.

questions.q: Determine the area of the region bounded by the curve y = x² and the line y = 4.
questions.explanation: The curves meet at x = −2 and x = 2. Area = ∫₋₂² (4 − x²) dx = 32/3.

questions.q: The area under the curve y = 1/x from x = 3 to x = 6 is
questions.explanation: Area = ∫₃⁶ dx/x = ln(6/3) = ln 2. The starting point does not matter, only the ratio.
